game_title: Patrol Decision Tree – Pearl Divers' Lagoon Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Coastal Port – Pearl Divers' Lagoon, a lagoon of pearl divers: the dock cartographer must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Patrol Decision Tree: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions.
theme: Coastal Port – Pearl Divers' Lagoon: a lagoon of pearl divers
core_gameplay_loop: In Pearl Divers' Lagoon, repeat each round: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions. Each round, rogue crabs strike the signal flag, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the cover value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the signal flag from rogue crabs in Pearl Divers' Lagoon: keep the cover meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 57-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: cover drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 57-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 10 (extended tier): Patrol Decision Tree
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Patrol Decision Tree' (Week 3 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Pearl Divers' Lagoon'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cover changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Pearl Divers' Lagoon.
